AI-generated news and signal analysis for a project. Each item includes title, summary, TL;DR, signal type, source URLs, and source tweet if applicable.

**Signal types:** `price_analysis`, `mindshare`, `funding`, `twitter`, `ai_twitter`.

**Lookup:** by UUID (`id`) or name (`q`). Filter by `lang` (en/zh/ja/kr). Returns 404 if not found.

params.name: metric
params.description: Metric to query. Can be `volume`, `fees` (or `fee` alias), `revenue`, `tvl`, or `users`. Defaults to tvl.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of time range. Accepts Unix seconds (`1704067200`) or date string (`2024-01-01`)

params.name: to
params.description: End of time range. Accepts Unix seconds (`1706745600`) or date string (`2024-02-01`)

params.name: chain
params.description: Filter by chain. Can be `ethereum`, `polygon`, `bsc`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `base`, `avalanche`, `fantom`, or `solana`.

items.docs:
Returns historical time-series for a single DeFi protocol metric (e.g. daily TVL). Each data point has a Unix timestamp and value.

**Available metrics:** `volume`, `fee`, `fees`, `revenue`, `tvl`, `users`.

**Lookup:** by UUID (`id`) or name (`q`). Filter by `chain` and date range (`from`/`to`). Returns 404 if the project is not found.

**Pagination:** check `meta.has_more`; when true, increase `offset` or `limit` to fetch the remaining points.

**Note:** this endpoint only returns data for DeF

Returns a DeFi protocol leaderboard (e.g. Aave, Uniswap, Lido) ranked by TVL, fees, revenue, or users. For individual pool/vault yields, use `onchain-yield-ranking` instead.

**Available metrics:** `tvl`, `revenue`, `fees`, `volume`, `users`.
